routines.name: assign_amount

sourceCorrespondence.view:
SELECT r.id,
        CASE s.read_class
            WHEN 'original'::text THEN jsonb_build_object('disposition', 'original', 'value',
            CASE
                WHEN r.amount IS NULL THEN 'null'::jsonb
                ELSE jsonb_build_object('integerToken', r.amount::text)
            END)
            WHEN 'masked'::text THEN '{"value": {"integerToken": "0"}, "disposition": "transformed"}'::jsonb
            ELSE '{"disposition": "withheld"}'::jsonb
        END AS cell
   FROM security_mask_write.resource r
     JOIN security_mask_write.subject s ON s.login = SESSION_USER::text
  WHERE s.read_class = ANY (ARRAY['original'::text, 'masked'::text, 'withheld'::text]);
